title: record page body tables: a currency column with no resolvable currency draws no total, even when the parent's stored roll-up sums the same rows
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZrgaiMgTJCnswR6jQ

Filing gate: ③ a measured finding of the A4 browser reading on PR #35691 (#35597, epic #35590): the PR body's "Browser reading (A4)" section, case 4, before/after screenshots in the area's project files. It is a child of #35597 and is nested under it. Not a regression of #35691: `origin/main`'s client totals line had the same gate.
Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/plugin-detail`). Suggested grade: p2, the parent's grade.
Dedupe: `body table total currency`, `useBodyTableTotals currency` → only #35597 and PR #35691.
Blocked-by: #35597 (the totals code this changes lands there).

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：明细表的金额列在没有设置币种时，也显示合计行。
- 为什么做：示例客户管理应用的商机明细，金额列没有币种，现在表格底部不显示合计，虽然服务器已经算好了总数。
- 出错会怎样：只影响合计行显示；没有币种时合计按普通数字显示，不加货币符号。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Facts

- On the CRM example, opportunity "Acme — Q3 Platform Renewal" (line_total 111,000): the line-item body table draws no total row, before and after PR #35691.
- `crm_opportunity_line_item.amount` is a currency field with no currency of its own, and the example sets no tenant default; its cells draw without a symbol (`6,000.00`).
- `useBodyTableTotals` (PR #35691) skips a currency column whose currency does not resolve (`if (!currency) continue`) BEFORE the stored roll-up branch, so the parent's same-rows roll-up is not used either. `main`'s client "Totals (this page)" had the same gate (`agreedRowCurrency`).
- Control: the showcase expense report draws "Total $1,500.50", equal to its stored roll-up.

## Ask

Decide and implement: when a currency column's currency does not resolve, draw its total the way its cells are drawn (number format, no symbol), from the same server source (same-rows roll-up, else the aggregate). Keep the record-currency grouping for columns whose currency is per record. Pin: a currency column with no resolvable currency draws a total equal to the server figure; CONTROL: a resolved currency still draws with its symbol.

⛔ Not a claim.
